dict.Intrările vin din nota de recepție (Shee: Receipts come from the goods received note (Sheets → Goods receipt note), issues from the delivery note, invoice or materials requisition.
dict.La inventariere, stocul la zi e cel din: At stocktaking, the current stock is the book stock (Sheets → Stocktaking list); differences are entered with the report.
dict.O fișă pentru fiecare produs din gestiun: One card for each product in the store (copy the sheet for the next product).
dict.Un produs dintr-un depozit sau magazin,: One product in a warehouse or shop, with every receipt and issue (document, date, from whom or to whom): the stock after each movement is calculated from the opening stock, and on the right you get the current stock, its value and the status: sufficient (green), to reorder below the minimum stock (yellow) or negative stock (red).
